ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow Shark to use the camera for QR code scanning.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Shark connects to the desktop app on your LAN.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Shark to use your microphone for voice dictation, transcribed on this phone or on your paired computer.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow Shark to save images from your sessions to Photos.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow Shark to attach photos from your library to a terminal session on your paired desktop.
